config.title: Z-MUSIC
config.syntax.version.description: Z-MUSIC syntax version used for lint and hover. With `auto`, a magic comment (e.g. `/ zmusic-version: 2`) at the top of the file wins; otherwise a heuristic decides (currently defaults to v2). V3 mode disables range checking (not implemented).
config.driver.path.description: Local file path for ZMUSIC.X. Takes priority over the globalStorage cache if set.
config.driver.downloadUrl.description: URL to fetch ZMUSIC.X from. Used when the first-launch QuickPick offers a download.
config.driver.version.description: Which ZMUSIC.X version to use. Only 2.08 is verified in v1 scope.
config.driverArgs.description: Command-line options passed to ZMUSIC.X on launch.
config.trace.enabled.description: Highlight the currently sounding note in the editor while playing.
config.trace.lineHighlight.description: Also apply a faint background colour to the whole line while highlighting.
config.trace.followCursor.description: Scroll the editor when the lowest-numbered playing track's position moves out of view.
config.trace.ptrAdjust.description: p_data_pointer offset. Adjust by ±1 to a few bytes if playback highlight appears one note ahead or behind the audible note.
config.player.revealOnPlay.description: Reveal the Player view automatically when playback starts.
